pages.title: Dimensional Lift Projector
pages.text: A lift that pushes along an extra dimension. With a tesseract core set inside the emitter stack, it can nudge anything in its field slightly outside ordinary space, where weight no longer applies. Riding it feels like being briefly folded, then gently unfolded somewhere higher.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Elevators need cables because they work in three dimensions. Mounting a Tesseract Core between graviton and field emitters, I found I could lift things by sliding them sideways through a fourth.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Geometry.
